intent: Reference-informed original, clean premium educational 3D explainers; not creator/voice impersonation or frame duplication
creative_grammar: macro contact -> internal cause -> consequence -> conditional reversal -> safe resolution
eye follows actual subject; focus transfer follows narrative
negative space and deliberate settles; no fake jitter

look.palette: restrained petrol/slate background, warm tissue, ivory cells/type, controlled steel; adapt to topic, not mandatory skin on everything
look.materials: localized pores/ridges, grain/fibres, brushed metal; bounded subtle relief, not uniformly glossy plastic
look.camera: purposeful macro angles, bounded C2 rails, explicit cuts, restrained selective focus
look.typography: one plain readable caption layer; sparse real extruded3D narrative words if earned

sound.taste: soft tactile contact/release/friction textures, no game/UI chirps
sound.music: credited original arrangement with measured build and warning-line negative space
sound.same_film_voice_policy: Fixed WAVs/script/placements retained unless authorized; no automatic cross-session voice-ID reuse

reject: claims that technical gates certify clinical/artistic perfection

scope_policy.whole_film_pass: cover every shot/scene group and compare with actual prior controls/images
scope_policy.new_topic: new factual mechanism, script/voice/geometry/action and shot plan; baseline is grammar/tooling, not canned content
